 See what the stars have in store for your sign By Snehaa Khanna Sahgal 9 November 2026 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) The way you may be looking at this situation in your life may simply have been a borrowed perspective from your environment, family, or those who shaped your early worldviews. Libra , it may be worth asking yourself if you feel you can or cannot do something because you feel this way or because it is what you believe to be true based on your learned values and limitations. Take the softer but more self-aware approach to a persistent challenge that life poses. You'd be surprised at how you emerge with better relationships and a fuller heart.
 Cosmic tip: Bask in your wisdom, and draw from your inner well.
